other_conditions: The applicant must be a voluntary organization recognized by the state government
The organization must be registered under the Societies Act
The organization must be actively working in the welfare of destitute and helpless individuals or have prior experience in this field
The organization must have a strong financial condition
The organization must not have been penalised or blacklisted in the past
The deceased must be identified as unclaimed or destitute with no known family or relatives
The death must have occurred within the jurisdiction of Rajasthan
The organization must agree to conduct the last rites immediately at its own level with full legal procedure and to receive reimbursement from the State Government
benefits_summary: A one-time grant of ₹5,000 is provided to voluntary organizations for conducting the last rites of unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
